title: Topograph: An efficient Graph-Based Framework for Strictly Topology Preserving Image Segmentation
mechanism: A component graph of prediction and label finds topologically critical regions, and the loss aggregates over them. It also defines a strict homotopy metric. About 5x faster than PH losses.
adaptation: Same use as Betti matching on crack (8-connectivity, components >= 20 px). Its homotopy metric is a candidate topology score for the benchmark.
min_experiment: Same design as Betti matching. Run whichever of the two installs cleanly.
evidence: R (abstract): state-of-the-art topology on binary and multi-class datasets, up to 5x faster loss than PH methods.

alt_notes.adaptation: Crack class, component (0-dim) errors only, restricted to label components >= 20 px so sub-20 px label fragments (76 to 88% of components) are not enforced. Its homotopy metric is a candidate topology score for the benchmark.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + Topograph (small weight) vs PF, 5 seeds. Kill if component recall (>= 20 px) gain < 0.02 or crack IoU < PF - 0.012.
